thread.title: New Apple Portal Allows Users Access to Their Data -Bloomberg

author: morningstar.com
title: New Apple Portal Allows Users Access to Their Data -Bloomberg
text:
--Apple Inc. (AAPL) introduced an online portal that will allow users in the U.S. to access and download data the company holds on them, Bloomberg reported Wednesday.
--The company launched a similar portal in Europe earlier this year, in order to comply with European data regulation rules, the report said.
--Users will be able to download information such as address book contacts, music streaming preferences and Apple product repairs, the report said.
Full story: https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2018-10-17/apple-launches-portal-for-u-s-users-to-download-their-data?srnd=premium
